There are always many people at the post office. Kate's birthday is in August. The weather was rainy that day. Best of all, the small island is a paradise for bird watchers.
Tom spent the weekend at the library. Last Tuesday, Tom and Kate went to the community center. Tom learned a lot about art. All students are welcome to participate in the art festival.

They took many photos at the post office. It takes twenty minutes to get to the community center by bike. The community center is one of the best places in the city. The ceiling light needs a new bulb.
Tom wants to be a doctor in the future. Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like soup and tea.
